question: Nagabhata was the king of which of the following dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pratihara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Raja Nagabhata I Pratihara was the founder of Bhinmal branch of Pratiharas.</
